title: No Audience
lessons: the difference between being seen and looking

text: The party is downstairs, performing through the ceiling.
Up here, the city is mostly windows deciding whether to stay lit.
Your phone is already in your hand.

choices.text: Put it away and watch the light change.
Send one honest message to the person you meant to call.

text: The typing bubble appears, then disappears, then returns.
You wait without making it a story.
